rca of the issue: Iteration_11 identified two independent bugs that made CR-109 dead code: (a) util looked for min_items/max_items/bonus_minutes but was invoked against a hypothetical schema shape; (b) profileTransform.settings did not expose the three new keys, so useRestaurant().settings.autoPrepTimeAck/prepTimeBonusConfig/defaultPrepTime were undefined. Iteration_12 verifies both are now fixed: transform adds the keys (with nested→root fallback), util handles both key variants with Number() coercion. Live fiber inspection confirms keys are present on rid=478 with expected values.
